motion: the water level rises slowly around the drain and barely goes down
the clump slides out slowly and drips
the screwdriver turns and the cover lifts revealing a dark opening
the strip is pulled slowly out covered in grey hair
the nut turns and dirty water pours into the bucket
the stopper lifts out with a wad of hair wrapped around its stem
the plunger compresses and releases and the water shakes
the head turns off the thread and lifts away
